stemMarkdown: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track 400 m long and run in opposite directions at 6 km/h and 3 km/h. After how many seconds do they meet for the first time? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions their speeds add: $2.5000$ m/s. Together they must cover one full lap, so they meet after $\dfrac{400}{2.5000} = 160.0$ seconds.
